summary: Namib Minerals filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its subsidiary, Bulawayo Mining Company, entered into a $5.0 million term-loan facility with Ecobank Zimbabwe Limited on June 5, 2026, to finance mining development. The loan carries a 12% base rate minus 1% margin, matures May 31, 2029, and is secured by $7.5 million in plant/machinery and assignment of gold-sales proceeds. This is a routine debt financing arrangement with no special-situation event such as M&A, restructuring, or tender offer.
